organisationId.description: Id of organisation owning the program

reference.description:
Unique reference for the program. Meant to be used to identify which program this is, across different environments
where the id might be different. This enables clients of the api to more easily identify the program, for example to
enrich the presentation, beyond what this api delivers (for example with an icon, or more descriptive text).

infoLink.description: A link to information about the program

organisationsWithAccess.description: A list of organisations that can consume the program

administratorOrganisations.description: A list of organisations that can administrate the program

items.description: A list of organisations that can administrate the program

active.description: If program is active. Inactive programs are excluded from triggering effects.
